title: Zopirus
summary: Raleigh names Zopirus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Zopirus, who for the loue he bare Darius cut off his owne Eares and Nose, and deliuered Babylon into Darius his hands. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
